Package neqsim.process.engineering.dexpi

Class Dexpi201DynamicBindingReader

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.dexpi.Dexpi201DynamicBindingReader
public final class Dexpi201DynamicBindingReader extends Object
Reads a controlled native DEXPI 2.0.1 P&ID into revision-bound executable simulation bindings.

The DEXPI document supplies exact drawing identities and relationships. The companion binding artifact supplies the explicit mapping to a governed executable model; this reader never infers tuning, set points, fail action, SIL, voting, fluid state, or missing process physics from drawing metadata. Any duplicate, missing, unresolved, type-incompatible, or stale identity fails before a caller can execute a scenario.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim development team
